From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@greenbridge.edu>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: academic research credits for Greenbridge AI Lab

Hi Rishi,

I'm Elaine Turner, Program Manager for the AI Lab at Greenbridge College. We're preparing a faculty-led research project (Prof. Rao is cc'd) that will involve 12 graduate students working on multi-turn conversational evaluation and embeddings for low-resource languages. We ran a short proof-of-concept on another platform and would like to evaluate Redwood for cheaper production inference and a potential campus partnership.

Request: could Redwood provide an academic trial allocation (trial credits or promo extension) to cover model inference for 3 months while we complete benchmark evaluations? Aim is roughly 75k tokens per month initially.

Attached is a short project summary and the college's standard PO template. Happy to provide institutional email verification or a faculty letter as needed.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing what’s possible.

Best,
Elaine Turner
Program Manager, AI Lab
Greenbridge College
(555) 412-9987

Hi Elaine — thanks for reaching out and for the proposal. Great to hear about the evaluation scope — low-resource language work is something we want to support.

Quick questions so I can route this correctly:
- Are the students using institutional emails for sign-up (ideally .edu addresses)?
- Is the project strictly non-commercial (research/publication) for the 3-month window?
- Do you need a single shared institutional account or separate accounts per student?

I’ve looped in Marissa (Academic Programs) to help with eligibility and credit allocation. If you can confirm the bullets above and reattach the PO (if you have one ready), we’ll try to expedite.

Action: Marissa — can you review eligibility and advise on a standard academic trial allocation we can approve without a sales contract? If we need any approvals, please flag.

Thanks,
Rishi

Rishi — reviewed the attached proposal and Greenbridge's PO template. Greenbridge is an accredited small college and this project looks squarely academic/nonprofit. Per our academic policy: verified faculty + institutional PO suffices for promo credits.

I recommend we approve a 75,000-token/month allocation for 3 months (total 225k tokens) as a self-serve credit grant tied to the account GB-2026-112. No contract needed; require institutional email verification and the signed PO on file. Please instruct Finance to create a credit authorization record and set expiry to 2027-01-31.

I’m copying Lauren to confirm the finance/fulfillment steps.

Hi Elaine — good news: we approved the academic trial for Greenbridge. Summary below and next steps.

What we issued:
- 225,000 token credit total (75k tokens/month for 3 months)
- Expiry: 2027-01-31
- Account: single shared institutional account under contact GB-2026-112

How to redeem:
1) Sign into https://console.redwood.ai with your institutional admin email (Elaine).
2) Under Billing > Credits, the 225k allocation will appear within 24 hours.
3) If students will use separate logins, add them via Settings > Team and assign usage roles.

Attachments included: redwood-credit-authorization-GB-2026-112.pdf (internal credit note).

One ask: can you send the signed PO (if you prefer a PO on file)? Lauren said uploading the PO speeds processing and is fine.

If you want, we can schedule a short onboarding session with our CS team next week to go over best practices for batching and embeddings cost control.

Best,
Rishi
